movie_title: The myth of Pegasus and the chimera - Iseult Gillespie
introduction: Discover the myth of Bellerophon, the hero who battled and killed the Chimera monster atop the winge

vocabulary.example: Finally, Pegasus was subdued by Bellerophon after he put the magical bridle on him.
When the Queen of Argos made advances towards him, Bellerophon rebuffed her, causing further tension.

vocabulary.definition: forced to leave one's home country or place of residence
vocabulary.example: After the incident with his brother, Bellerophon was exiled to Argos by King Proetus.

vocabulary.definition: admit that something is true or valid after first denying or resisting it
vocabulary.example: Iobates had no choice but to concede that Bellerophon was indeed a true hero after witnessing his bravery.
Bellerophon's hubris led him to believe he was entitled to a place on Mount Olympus, which ultimately led to his downfall.

vocabulary.definition: move swiftly and in an uncontrolled way
vocabulary.example: After being flung into the air by Pegasus, Bellerophon fell careening back to Earth, realizing his ambitious dreams were shattered.
